Maya (CS): Quick handback note — I finished the field handback for Acme pilot and wanted to share the suggested prefetch/sequencing checklist.
Sam W: Nice, can you drop the checklist here?
Maya (CS): TL;DR checklist for handback: 
1) Tenant segmentation: low/med/high QPS + expected peak windows
2) Prefill waves: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (48h between waves for telemetry)
3) Client readiness probe: endpoint + success threshold (200 OK + avg latency < 120ms)
4) Warm pools: size by segment, TTLs per model variant
5) Fallback plan: model variant routing + soft-rate-limit for noisy tenants
6) Cost guardrails: spend cap + alert hook
Olivia - Solutions: Add: set interactive cache TTL=30s, batch TTL=5m. Also log sampling at 1% during wave 1, 5% wave 2.
Ben R: Here's a tiny prefill caller you can use in field to trigger a wave (replace $TOKEN):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-prod","wave":10,"mode":"staged"}'
```
Maya (CS): onboard-bot queued a prefill job for acme-prod during the demo — please monitor.
onboard-bot: Prefill job queued for tenant acme-prod (job-id: jf-3421) :white_check_mark:
Sam W: For troubleshooting — watch for kv-cache miss spikes and token burn. If miss-rate > 15% after wave 2, pause and revert to warm-pool-only.
Olivia - Solutions: Ops tip: stagger client retry jitter (100-800ms) to avoid thundering, and set per-tenant batching limit to avoid cross-tenant tail latency.
Maya (CS): Follow-ups: @Olivia run a canary for wave 1 tomorrow 10:00 PT, @Ben R watch spend + logs, I'll schedule a 15m handback sync right after.
Ben R: I'll save this thread to the enablement doc under "field handback patterns" — internal link: https://redwood.internal/docs/enablement/field-handback (will add checklist copy).
Maya (CS): Final acceptance criteria to include in handback doc: success telemetry stable for 48h, no SLO breaches, and customer-run smoke test passes.
Sam W: LGTM :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — will post the finalized checklist here after the canary and attach the post-canaary incident hooks.
